paragraphs.text: Cloud Service Agreement
Key Terms between Northgate Systems Ltd ("Provider") and Fairhaven Retail Ltd ("Customer").
General Cap Amount: 0.5x the Fees paid or payable by Customer in the 12 months before the claim.
Payment Period: 30 days from the invoice date.
Term: The Agreement starts on the Effective Date and continues for 12 months.
Security. Provider will maintain reasonable administrative, physical and technical safeguards to protect Customer Content.
Breach notice. Provider will notify Customer of any Security Breach without undue delay and in any event within 72 hours.
Definitions. "Customer Content" means all data submitted to the Cloud Service by or for Customer.
Governing Law: the laws of England and Wales.
Liability. Each party's total liability under this Agreement will not exceed the General Cap Amount.
